region.why: a deployment fact: HCAZERRS ASSIGNs SYSID into the message it writes; the corpus names no region

notes: The example-health-apis threshold REST wrapper HCTRESTW, started with a channel (no COMMAREA): GET CONTAINER DFHHTTPMETHOD picks GET, PUT or POST, and the DFHWS-URIMAPPATH, DFHWS-URI-QUERY, DFHWS-URI-RESID and DFHWS-DATA containers carry the request. The scenarios are the paths that end before any LINK of HCT1BI01 / HCT1BA01 / HCT1BU01 or a PUT of DFHWS-DATA / DFHRESPONSE: a LINK to a program the case does not run refuses the case, HCT1BU01 is not in the estate, and a PUT of a DFH container other than DFHREQUEST / DFH-BODY / DFH-DATA is refused by name (X42). Derived from IBM's example-health-apis (github.com/ibm/example-health-apis, Apache-2.0; (C) Copyright IBM Corp. 2011, 2014): LICENSE here is the corpus's own, NOTICE names the source and what was derived. DISPLAY output is not compared (sysout false): the Java side of a CICS run of an estate with no batch package writes it to stdout, not to the task's .sysout file (P128).

scenarios.name: unsupported-method
scenarios.why: DELETE: the EVALUATE of WS-HTTP-METHOD falls to WHEN OTHER and ABENDs UMET

scenarios.name: no-channel
scenarios.why: no channel: GET CONTAINER DFHHTTPMETHOD cannot succeed, ABEND MEAB

scenarios.name: method-container-missing
scenarios.why: a channel that holds no DFHHTTPMETHOD: GET CONTAINER is not NORMAL, ABEND MEAB

scenarios.name: post-no-resid
scenarios.why: POST without DFHWS-URI-RESID: GET-RESID takes the RESA abend

scenarios.name: post-no-root-data
scenarios.why: POST without DFHWS-DATA: GET-REQUEST-ROOT-DATA is not NORMAL, GENERIC-ABEND ERRS
